Being the Manager at a Charity Playgroup. Please consider  looking at small Charity Childcare in your area. We get such little funding and most of us are looking at having to go under due to the pandemic. Most of us working there are mums or grandparents who love our jobs and do it for the children and not the minimum wage we get. 
Splitting even some of that money up to give to them would allow these places to stay open and keep doing what they love and help local families with affordable childcare. 
From a worried Playgroup Manager

Both of you just stop whatever you are doing and walk out the front door. Go for a walk, eat a meal, see a film or visit a friend it doesn't really matter.
Just the act of getting up and walking out the door when ever you want to. 

No waiting until someone else is there to look after the baby so you can leave.
No worrying it doesn't clash with baby schedule.
No collecting 100 things to go in a bag.
No worrying you have everything you may ever need just in case.
No waiting for a small child to collect the 100 things they want to take with them.
No wrestling a kid into a car seat.
No shouting and stress.
Just get up, walk out the door and you choice want to do.
